::::{#thm-truncated-power-spline}
#### Truncated power functions are splines

Let $d \ge 1$ be an integer and $\xi$ a knot.
The truncated power function $h(x) \eqdef (x - \xi)_+^d$
is a spline of degree $d$ with knot $\xi$ (@def-spline):
its derivatives of orders $0, 1, \ldots, d-1$ are continuous at $\xi$.
Its $d$-th derivative jumps from $0$ to $d!$ at $\xi$.

Consequently, every function of the form

$$\b_0 + \b_1 x + \cdots + \b_d x^d + \sum_{k=1}^K \b_{d+k} (x - \xi_k)_+^d$$

is a spline of degree $d$ with knots $\xi_1, \ldots, \xi_K$
[@wood2017generalized, §4.2; @james2021islr2e, §7.4].
::::
